evidence: outbound_field_diff.py:199-201: `outbound_mapper._assignee_resolver = (lambda lv: assignee_resolver(lv, jira_key))`
backend.py:150: `self.outbound = _JiraOutbound()` — a single instance per backend, shared across all tickets in a pass

dropped.finding: `compute_update_fields` injects the per-key assignee resolver by mutating `outbound_mapper._assignee_resolver` on the shared singleton `backend.outbound` instance and never clears it. It is overwritten per-ticket within a pass (so intra-pass behavior is correct), but leaves a stale closure bound to the last jira_key on the shared object after the pass, which any out-of-band resolve_assignee call would then use.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Only resolve `inbound_mapper` from the registry when the update path actually needs it (or preserve the pre-625b behavior of not loading config when `outbound_mapper` is injected), so single-mapper callers keep working.
evidence: outbound_differ.py:445 `if outbound_mapper is None or inbound_mapper is None:` then `select_backend(load_config())` at :449
Pre-625b the branch was `if outbound_mapper is None:` (diff hunk shows the old single-condition guard), so passing `outbound_mapper` alone skipped config loading entirely

Concrete affected caller: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_backend_neutrality.py:291-296 `compute_outbound_mutations([ticket], {}, _NeutralityStubBindingStore(), outbound_mapper=fake)` injects only outbound_mapper (no inbound_mapper) — under the new guard this now calls load_config()+select_backend() even though the unbound ticket takes the CREATE path where inbound_mapper is unused
dropped.finding: The mapper-injection fallback guard in compute_outbound_mutations widened from `if outbound_mapper is None` to `if outbound_mapper is None or inbound_mapper is None`, so a direct caller that injects ONLY `outbound_mapper` (and omits `inbound_mapper`) now triggers a live `load_config()` + `select_backend()` it previously skipped — a behavior change for existing single-mapper callers.
scenarios: A unit/fixture caller injecting only outbound_mapper to stay hermetic now performs real config resolution
A pure-create run (all tickets unbound) needlessly loads config + selects a backend because inbound_mapper defaults to None
dropped.suggested_fix: Resolve each mapper independently and lazily — e.g. only call `select_backend(load_config())` for `inbound_mapper` when a bound ticket reaches the update path, or split the guard so injecting `outbound_mapper` alone does not force config loading for create-only runs.
